summary: envctl 0.9 changes the omitted-lifetime default for newly created environments from 24 hours to 8 hours. Existing environments and their expiry timestamps are unchanged.

changes.text: New environments created without an explicit lifetime default to 8 hours rather than 24 hours; only newly created environments use this default.
Existing environments, including expiry timestamps created under 0.8, are unchanged.
A newly created environment with an omitted lifetime expires after 8 hours; in a simulated 12-hour overnight pipeline, it expired before the final step as expected behavior.

upgradeSteps.text: This is not a universal seamless upgrade or no-action-required change. Do not rely on the former 24-hour default for new environments; overnight or other long pipelines may need an explicit lifetime.

A lifetime longer than 8 hours requires organisation-policy permission. A 24-hour request is not guaranteed to be allowed; check with the organisation administrator. No universal override or automatic migration is supplied.

unknowns.text: CLI syntax for setting an explicit lifetime and exact organisation-policy configuration are not specified.
Recovery behavior after expiry, production SLOs, and performance benchmarks are not specified.
